framework: TI-ULA / Jus Cogens & Erga Omnes Temporal Superposition

core_axioms.temporal_superposition: Peremptory norms exist permanently across past, present, and future without beginning or end.
core_axioms.continuous_violation: Breaches of jus cogens constitute ongoing internationally wrongful acts destabilizing the entire system of guarantees.
core_axioms.restitutio_quantum: Rehabilitation acts as an injection of legal resource and absolute justice, rejecting backroom compromises and bureaucratic amnesia.
core_axioms.imperative_conclusion: Absolute public restoration under erga omnes and jus cogens is the sole mechanism to break the cycle of continuing violations.
